rationale: The pinned 6.10.0 source is interactive-only and halts at each menu. Forge adds a bounded headless invocation that must supply reviewed answers for the same six checkpoints and produces the same report topology; all filesystem, process, model, persistence, and Help-following effects remain typed host plans.
migrationPolicy: Re-review and regenerate the adapter, fixtures, Help topology, and persisted binding whenever the pinned Method source version, six-step workflow, invocation-mode contract, or Forge 0.1 execution contract changes.
